entity.summary: Iranian centralized cryptocurrency exchange offering rial- and stablecoin-denominated spot markets, instant purchase and sale, custody, trading tools, mobile access, and authenticated API order execution.
entity.notes: The current first-party site presents more than 320 trading markets, instant purchase and sale, authenticated accounts, mobile applications, and API trading. The U.S. Treasury designated Wallex on 2026-06-02 pursuant to E.O. 13902 for operating in Iran's financial sector. The designation is recorded as a regulatory event and does not by itself establish operational closure; the exchange remains active. No exact launch date is asserted.

events.title: U.S. Treasury designated Wallex under Iran sanctions authority
events.description: The U.S. Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control designated Wallex pursuant to Executive Order 13902 for operating in the financial sector of the Iranian economy.
events.notes: The designation creates sanctions exposure but the reviewed first-party platform remains operational, so HEI does not infer a shutdown or terminal status.

evidence.title: Wallex cryptocurrency exchange platform
evidence.notes: Current first-party platform presents more than 320 rial- and USDT-based trading markets, instant purchase and sale, registration, mobile access, trading tools, custody, and API functions.

evidence.title: Economic Fury targets Iranian digital asset exchanges
evidence.notes: Official Treasury release identifies Wallex as an Iranian digital-asset exchange and records its designation pursuant to E.O. 13902 for operating in Iran's financial sector.
